directional_numeric_value_flow.origin: t.getDamage(self, t) returns combatTalentSpellDamage(t, 20, 140); Combat.lua computes the scalar from talent level and spellpower, with Magic contributing through spellpower.
directional_numeric_value_flow.action_crit: action passes t.getDamage(self, t) to spellCrit, which may multiply that scalar by critical power.
directional_numeric_value_flow.action_projection: action projects the resulting scalar once through a hit target descriptor as DamageType.FIRE to the selected target.
directional_numeric_value_flow.action_temporal_shape: No DamageType.FIREBURN projector or EFF_BURNING application occurs in the action; this is immediate FIRE damage with no duration, per-turn split, or DoT.
directional_numeric_value_flow.tooltip: info obtains t.getDamage without spellCrit and passes it to damDesc(self, DamageType.FIREBURN, damage).
directional_numeric_value_flow.placeholder: The single returned damDesc scalar binds the single %0.2f placeholder; no other numeric or temporal placeholder exists.
directional_numeric_value_flow.displayed_quantity: an uncritted tooltip damage scalar, not a three-turn total and not per-turn damage

damdesc_fireburn_semantics.type_lookup: damDesc resolves the FIREBURN damage-type record only to inspect damdesc_split.
damdesc_fireburn_semantics.no_split: DamageType.FIREBURN defines no damdesc_split field at the fixed commit, so damDesc leaves the type as FIREBURN and never calls the FIREBURN projector.
damdesc_fireburn_semantics.scalar_handling: damDesc applies its status-based display modifiers and, when inc_damage exists, combatGetDamageIncrease(FIREBURN); it returns one scalar.
damdesc_fireburn_semantics.no_three_turn_conversion: The FIREBURN projector's default duration 3 and initial 50 are projector behavior only. damDesc does not execute that projector, does not subtract an initial portion, and does not divide a remainder by three.
damdesc_fireburn_semantics.translation_consequence: The FIREBURN damDesc argument therefore does not make either language's flame-damage sentence a DoT, duration, total-over-time, or per-turn claim.

upstream_display_inconsistency.crit_difference: The action calls spellCrit; info does not.
upstream_display_inconsistency.damage_increase_difference: Because FIREBURN has no damdesc_split, damDesc queries FIREBURN-keyed damage increase rather than FIRE-keyed damage increase and may omit the FIRE-specific increase relevant to the action.
upstream_display_inconsistency.scope_decision: This discrepancy belongs to upstream action/info display code. The frozen English and Chinese bind the same one scalar and make the same non-temporal claim, so it is not a translation correctness defect and mod-tome.lua remains unchanged.

confirmed.subject: action semantics
confirmed.finding: spellCrit(getDamage) is projected as immediate DamageType.FIRE to one hit target; there is no BURNING or DoT.

confirmed.subject: tooltip semantics
confirmed.finding: info formats uncritted getDamage through damDesc(FIREBURN); this creates neither duration nor per-turn semantics and may omit FIRE-specific damage increase compared with the action.

no_change.reason: English and Chinese each bind one %0.2f and claim only flame damage plus Magic scaling; neither claims duration, total-over-time, or per-turn damage.
